data_fields.name: blessing_constant
data_fields.donor_constant: constant argument of STAT_BOOST / STAT_HEAL / STAT_SUB / STAT_ADD / STAT_DRAIN (per script call)

data_fields.name: blessing_percent
data_fields.donor_constant: percent argument (of base, or of current for STAT_DRAIN)

best_idea: One current-vs-base ladder where a blessing is a boost that never lowers the stat and a curse is a drain, with the boost decaying back toward base on a timer, so buffs and curses end by themselves.
decision_why: Take the ladder shape (boost capped at base + boost, heal capped at base, curse by base or by current, decay toward base) as the blessing and curse rows; set the cap, the decay interval and the floor as our own data; fix the donor's decay clock start and clamp the luck roll level to 1..99.
acceptance: A +10 blessing on a base-40 stat shows 50; a second +10 leaves it at 50; a heal of 20 from 30 shows 40; after 10 decay steps (N ticks each) the stat is back at base; a server test asserts each number.
